description.value:
You become aware of the presence, rough location, and nature of any trap within 120 feet of you and within your line of sight — meaning any device or mechanism, deliberately built by its creator, that would trigger a sudden, harmful, or unwanted effect.

While this power lasts, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to locate traps within your line of sight.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
